overall: MARGINAL overall: workable on the Coron side and in the south, wind-limited in the west all day and tonight
limiterDetail: The main limiter is wind in the west (east to northeast winds, 15–21 kt at Nangalao, Cabunlawan, Decabaitot, Ciron and Barangonan), plus current at the two pickups in the south. Wind now is 5–17 kt (gusts 8–22): Nangalao 17, Ciron 15, Cabunlawan and Decabaitot 13, Barangonan 10, and 5–8 kt elsewhere. Rain is minor: light showers about 9–11 AM in the west (up to 0.4 mm/h at Barangonan), a brief light shower around noon–2 PM on the Coron side, about 6–8 PM at Alava and Binudac (0.4 mm/h), and about 3–5 AM Thu in the west (up to 0.7 mm/h at Nangalao); 24h totals 0–3.3 mm. The current picks up about 7–11 AM (peak 8–9 AM), eases about noon–3 PM , picks up again about 5–9 PM (peak 6–8 PM), and goes slack on the Coron side and in the south about 11 PM–3 AM Thu.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since yesterday afternoon
items: The west-side wind no longer eases this afternoon. It now holds 17–21 kt all day and through the night into Thursday dawn at Nangalao, Cabunlawan, Decabaitot, Ciron and Barangonan (yesterday it was forecast to ease after about 1 PM). Linapacan joins at 14–16 kt from about 8 AM, and Alava and Binudac reach 12–14 kt late morning to afternoon. That costs the west a full day and a night trip, so Thursday's supply stays SOFT.

There's a small upside further out: the regional Thursday forecast eased to 9.8 kt, gusts 15 (was 14 kt, gusts 20), and Friday is calmer at 4.8 kt, so Friday 30 arrivals improve to SLIGHTLY SOFT (was soft). Week shifts: Sat 31 is wetter (5.1 mm, was 1.4) but still GOOD. Sun 1 and Mon 2 are both wetter and breezier (about 9.8 mm each, 11–12 kt, gusts 16–17). Tue 3 looks good. Right now the grounds read 7 GOOD / 7 MARGINAL / 2 POOR / 0 VERY POOR (was 7 / 9 / 0 / 0 at 2 PM yesterday). PAGASA has nothing for Palawan.
